units: <cite ref="Targum Jonathan on I Samuel 17:5">Targ. I Sam. XVII, 5</cite> (v. Lag. I, p. XVI) <he>שריין דגלד נוני ימא</he> (ed. <he>שרין גלבין</he>) a coat of mail made of the skin of sea-fishes (h. text <he>קשקשים</he>).—

<cite ref="Sanhedrin 110a">Snh. 110ᵃ</cite>; <cite ref="Pesachim 119a:12">Pes. 119ᵃ</cite> <he>אקלידי וקלפי דג׳</he> (Ms. M. <he>קופלי</he>, v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note) the keys and the locks (the stiff rims of the bags usually of metal) were of leather (so as to be of light weight).
